items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: these people who started with Coltrane... it's sterile; it's got no body to it.

ctx.x: You can get some really exciting music. But this stuff now, as brilliant as it is, a lot of brilliant music-- these people who started with Coltrane--it's do impossible things -- but it's sterile; it's got no body to it. A lot of that music, you hear from all those guys taking all these courses and running up and down the horns the way they do -- it's like an egg that's been punctured and there's no inside to it, just like a shell.
Well, that's what they preserve, and not the really golden stuff of like your generation or even before, like your bands and so forth.
